CourseOffering.name: CourseOffering
CourseOffering.description: Represents an instance of a training course with location and date details of training courses.

AcademicSessionId.description: The Academic Session associated with the Course Offering.

EnrolleeCount.description: The current number of enrollees in the Course Offering.

EnrollmentCapacity.description: The maximum number of students that are allowed to enroll for the Course Offering.

IsActive.description: Indicates whether the Course Offering is active (true) or not (false).

LearningCourseId.description: The Learning Course record associated with the Course Offering.

PrimaryFacultyId.description: The Contact associated with the Course Offering as lead instructor.

SectionNumber.description: Differentiates a Course Offering from other sections in an academic term.

WaitlistCapacity.description: The maximum number of students that can be waitlisted for the Course Offering.

WaitlistCount.description: The current number of people on the waitlist for the Course Offering.

CourseNameId.description: The ID of the course name.

EndDate.description: The end date of the course.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record.

LocationId.description: The ID of the location this course was offered.

Name.description: The name of the course offered.

OwnerId.description: The ID of the owner of this record.

StartDate.description: The start date of the course.

IsWaitlistActive.description: Indicates whether the course offering has an active waitlist (true) or not (false).

WaitlistStatus.description: Specifies the status of the waitlist associated with the course offering.

AvailabilityStatus.description: Specifies whether seats are available in a course offering or on its waitlist for an eligible student.

AdditionalLanguagePercentage.description: The percentage of the course offering taught in a language other than the primary language.

CourseOffering.accessRules: These fields are available only if United Kingdom Compliance and Configuration is turned on.
